memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you. I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you." - Gen 17:6-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God's promise keeps expanding - nations, kings, an everlasting covenant reaching to generations Abraham would never meet. But notice the heart of it all, tucked in the middle: "to be your God and the God of your descendants after you." Above the land, above the nations, above the kings, the greatest promise is God Himself. He pledges to be their God.

This is the essence of every covenant God makes. Underneath all the gifts is the Giver. The promise isn't merely "I will give you good things" but "I will be your God." That is the treasure - to belong to Him and have Him belong to us.

Notice too the word "everlasting." God's commitment isn't a temporary arrangement; it stretches across generations, unbreakable and enduring. What God begins with one person, He extends to families and generations. Our faith is never only about us; it reaches forward to those who come after.

This everlasting covenant finds its fullest expression in the gospel, where God's ancient promise - "I will be their God, and they will be my people" (Jer 31:33) - comes true for all who are in Christ. The deepest blessing God offers you is not a thing but Himself. And that promise doesn't end with you; pray it forward into your children and grandchildren, that He would be their God too.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you treasure God's gifts more than God Himself?
- Are you praying God's covenant faithfulness forward into the next generation?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, thank You that Your greatest promise is Yourself - to be my God. Help me treasure You above all Your gifts, and I pray Your covenant faithfulness forward into the generations after me.
Amen.
